title: Container Bookings: Admission of a Booking Request to a Product
content:
Before a Container Bookings request can be confirmed under a given product, the request must fit that product. This page states what "fitting" requires.

## Policy clause

A request is admitted to a product only if every one of the following holds. It arrives through a channel the product accepts; its cargo category is one the product takes; its container quantity does not exceed the product's container ceiling; its requested departure date is at most the product's booking horizon, in calendar days, beyond the request date; and it is received no less than the product's lead time, in hours, ahead of the cargo cut-off of the sailing asked for. In addition, the customer's credit standing must not be on credit hold.

Spot rating and contract rating exclude each other on a single booking. A product that does not permit a contract reference (AHL Spot Saver, AHL Spot Flex) must carry no contract at all; the two contract-rated products, AHL Contract Booking and AHL Contract Priority, cannot be requested without naming a service contract; AHL Guaranteed Loading and AHL Premium Express may be requested on either basis.

Wherever a service contract is referenced, it must be in active status, it must belong to the customer making the request, it must cover the trade lane of the booking, its contract tier rank must be no lower than the lowest rank the product accepts, and the scheduled departure must fall on or before the contract's expiry date. In consequence, AHL Contract Priority can be requested only by a customer whose referenced contract is an AHL Key Account Contract or ranks above it.

A request that fails any condition is declined through the confirmation and decline handling, and nothing is charged. The desk may point the customer to another product whose conditions the request does meet, but it never moves the request into a different product unless the customer so instructs.

## Where each fact is read

| Condition | Authoritative record | Tied to |
|---|---|---|
| Credit standing | the customer profile (cash in advance or credit approved pass; credit hold fails) | the requesting customer |
| Contract status, holder, lane, tier rank, expiry | the service contract record | the contract referenced on the request |
| Channel, cargo category, quantity, dates, cut-off | the request itself and the sailing asked for | this request |

The customer's own statement does not replace any of these records.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Quantity exactly equal to the container ceiling: within the limit.
- Departure falling exactly on the last day of the booking horizon: within the horizon.
- Request received exactly the lead time ahead of the cargo cut-off: in time.
- Scheduled departure on the contract's expiry date itself: permitted; one day after it: not permitted.

## Basis Q&A

**Can a spot product be booked with a contract reference if the customer holds a contract?** No; AHL Spot Saver and AHL Spot Flex must carry none.

**Does a contract held by another customer qualify?** No; the referenced contract must be held by the requesting customer itself.
